policy_resolution.resolution_note: The requested historical judge:eu:placementv1 is not authoritative under CURRENT_TRUE_ONLY. Current claim placement resolves to judge:evidence-placement:presentation-v1.2; current EUG presentation resolves to judge:evidence-graphic:presentation-v3.

requested_layout_contract.invariant: No new semantic section is created for a graph. Each EUG remains a child of an already existing S-series section and functions as a side illustration of that section.
Section IDs, canonical relative order, headings, visible copy, citations, CTA routes, qualification controls and graph data remain unchanged.
Desktop layout uses a right-side evidence rail; narrow layouts stack the EUG after the section content without changing semantic order.
No EUG may become a decorative diagram; all current marks, values, units, labels, source links and boundaries remain bound to the QGEU.
requested_layout_contract.dom_pattern: [EXISTING SECTION CONTENT, UNCHANGED]

placement.semantic_fit: Illustrates that reviewed potential signals originate from multiple source families; it remains contextual evidence, not detection-quality proof.
Illustrates the operational distinction between reviewed potential signals and their dispositions; it must not be interpreted as a causal funnel or client benchmark.
Illustrates why a safety-source pipeline includes explicit data-quality work; row-specific scales remain mandatory and cross-row bar lengths are not comparable.
Illustrates a bounded research benchmark while keeping the cohort and non-production boundary adjacent to the evidence section.

web_verification.boundary: Web verification confirms addressability and source content only. It does not satisfy the current hash-materialized source-closure requirement.

deterministic_decision.gate: Every graph is mapped to an existing section and no standalone EUG section is introduced.
The change requires only wrappers/aside placement inside four existing sections; no section order or content mutation is required.
Origin HTML/CSS/JS bytes are not materialized; 100% visual-fidelity mutation cannot be proven.
The dark repository preview has 15 top-level sections while the live source-of-truth snapshot has 23 semantic surfaces.
All four QGEUs have zero current StatisticsDisplayMetadata objects.
All four QGEUs have zero current OrderingContract and zero current OrderingQualityGate objects.
All four QGEUs have zero current READY hash-verified OriginDocumentArtifact objects.
Current QGEUs remain pending canonical Factfulness and blocked for agent exploitation.
No current judge:evidence-graphic:presentation-v3 PASS exists for the immutable target snapshot.
No unanimous three-replica judge:evidence-placement:presentation-v1.2 PASS exists for a rebinding against the current page snapshot.

mutation_decision.reason: DEVICEV CURRENT_TRUE_ONLY and fail-closed rules prohibit modified EUG placement until source closure, statistical display metadata, deterministic ordering, Factfulness/agent-exploitability and current presentation judges pass. The existing dark preview is also not topologically equivalent to the 23-surface live source.
mutation_decision.allowed_next_action: Materialize the exact current page source and QGEU source artifacts; complete v2 display/order contracts; bind the immutable snapshot; run the applicable current judges; then apply the four side-rail placements as one topology-preserving HTML patch.
